_comment: TRACE-Kin v3 config: v1 GNN backbone + 768-d molecular embedding global graph context. Molecular embedding (MoLFormer-XL or pre-computed ChemBERT depending on --molformer_path) is projected to hidden_channels via a single zero-initialized Linear and added as a residual to mol_pool before a fresh regression head. SWA enabled (start at epoch frac 0.5) to average weights over the noisy val plateau — single-epoch best-checkpoint selection was picking lucky early dips driven by small-val-set noise. Patience disabled when SWA is active so SWA's averaging window has room to build (set patience=0).
